notes: The ASV's He hath done all things well reorders πάντα … Καλῶς; rule 15 permits the discontinuity in the verb's unit.
ὑπερπερισσῶς heads on measure under rule 17's meaning-bearing complement, beyond spelling the ὑπερ-.
Καλῶς is not οὕτως, so no correlative competes and rule 65's English-side test gives the intensifying καί its written even; rule 100 is not in question.
